prompt: You test which paper plane flies farthest. You change the wing shape — but throw harder when you like a design. Fair test?

choices.text: Fair — wing shape is the only change
Fair — farther flight proves the design
Unfair — you should change throw strength too

explanation: Two things changed: wing shape and throw strength. You can't tell which made it fly farther.
science_idea: A fair test changes only one independent variable.
